criteria.title: 전역 에너지 balance
criteria.text:
d(∥u∥²₂/2)/dt+ν∥∇u∥²₂=⟨f,u⟩를 전체 K에서 적분한다. core만의 에너지와 구분한다. 합격: 정규화 energy defect가
독립 space/time refinement에서 감소한다. ν=1에서 (10.13)의 ∥u(t)∥² ₂+2∫∥∇u∥²₂≤(∫∥f∥₂)² 상계와 모순 없어야
한다.

criteria.title: 공간·급수·정밀도 적응
criteria.text:
core radius, axial length, pulse wavelength, active cutoff orders를 함께 해결한다. 각 refinement 축을 독립 증가시킨
다. 합격: 2배 grid, Fourier cutoff, coefficient order, arithmetic precision 비교표와 별도 tail bound를 저장한다. 예산
초과 시 last-resolved τ와 원인을 표시한다.

scope: Original normalized whole-K localization slab 1/2 <= rho <= 1

variables.time_measure: dt = -tau0 d rho, reversed time integration limits

background.seam: a cutoff argument equal to 1 has zero value and all derivatives zero

narrow_window_obstruction.conclusion: The current single fixed-J q window cannot cover the whole original slab.

materialization_frontier.archived_stage: first post-Signed FiveMap and whole-3D residual AST

data.flat_terms: retained separately, never sent to supported pulse source
data.physical_labels: all original cover labels with fixed path/copies; no sampling

data.equation: L_m(t_m,pi_m)=-f_m for EACH nonzero grouped supported source
data.initial_data: zero at entrance to same fixed path
data.velocity: cut off potential then full curl
data.pressure: inhomogeneous coefficient including n dot f
data.norm_theorem: generic stable forced class recurrence; input seminorm remains that of supported above
data.returned_complete_state: input_current plus the actual realized velocity increment; retain all previous wave/mean components and all previous angular pressure plus actual new angular pressure coefficient
data.all_cross_terms: Form complete updated full auxiliary covariance BEFORE any Haar averaging; do not replace it by its average for pressure or direct PDE.
data.next_action: FullPressureAndResidualRefresh on this complete state before any subsequent source projection

materialization_frontier.scope: The archived runner calls the first Forced constructor once on the privately initialized input. It emits no second-cycle call and no final gauge roots.

remaining.N7-06: Full source stage and coefficient roots plus actual cell field enclosures, then independently refined global energy, dissipation, work and force norm.
remaining.N8-05: Final-field spatial, Fourier, coefficient and precision refinements with uniform tails. Chart support work gives no final last-resolved tau.
